tasks.short: Write setup instructions and cutter lists

steps.what: Verify setup details, cutter selections and controller requirements for instruction sheets
Write instruction sheets and cutter lists and prepare the required controller encoding
Check exact instruction sheets, cutter lists and encoding before storing the accepted pack

tasks.design: Configure native setup-document exports and qualified encoding in {OTHER}, the existing manufacturing software. The programmer supplies exact setup notes and checks the generated pack against the program before storing the accepted version in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated transcription of tool lists, setup fields and controller-format copies.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and qualified format exports can reuse checked program metadata.
tasks.still_hard: Ensuring instructions describe the actual fixture, offsets and controller requirements.
tasks.human_edge: The programmer checks the physical meaning of instructions and encoding.

reach.learn: Which details are essential at the machine

evidence.claim: Native manufacturing templates can merge checked setup fields and cutter lists; qualified format export can prepare controller copies without generative code.

assumptions: OTHER means existing computer-aided manufacturing software; test its native setup sheets and encoding first.

The programmer's separate machining tasks produce the checked program and tool selections. In s1 the programmer captures program/revision, machine/controller, units, fixture, work offsets, cutter identifier/geometry, tool sequence, exact setup notes and required output format. Capture and checking take the full 30%; absent data or unsupported media require manual preparation.
A manufacturing engineer qualifies template field mappings and encoding profiles in 5 incremental other-role hours per 100 baseline. No free verified-offset or controller-compatible flag is assumed.
This task ends at checked setup documents and encoded copy. Physical media handling, machine setup and prove-out remain counted elsewhere and unchanged; already automatic exports earn zero.
research_questions: How much setup-document preparation remains manual after native exports?

incremental.description: Template validation and extra regression checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact setup pack and encoded-copy hashes, program revision, tool list, offsets, fixture and controller profile; changes void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=55, gross=45%; minus 8 focal upkeep gives net 37%. Range 0-10% allows existing exports, unusual controller media and substantial manual checks; unmeasured E1.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Machining judgement with less setup-document transcription
role.ambitious_version: A checked program produces consistent setup documents while the programmer verifies every machine-specific detail.
